categories.title: Janie's Recovery & Cozy Car Setup
categories.subtitle: Everything within arm's reach in the front seat so you stay super comfortable.

items.text: Soft lumbar pillow + seat cushion for the passenger seat
Cozy cream throw blanket + warm fuzzy socks
All medications, dosage schedule, and water bottle within easy reach
Ice pack / warm compress pack + small insulated cooler bag
Easy slip-on walking shoes for Franklin Main St and Chattanooga Bridge
Two insulated travel mugs for coffee runs + favorite road-trip snacks
Sunglasses, lip balm, hand lotion, tissues, and hair clips/scrunchies
Downloaded podcasts, audiobooks, road-trip playlist, and long phone charger cable
Lactaid (keep handy up front for coffee stops, restaurants & Thanksgiving feast)

categories.title: Winston's 70 lb Co-Pilot Pack
categories.subtitle: Keep his essentials right at the top of the trunk for quick rest-stop hops.

items.text: Festive red/green plaid bandana + grey harness + backup collar with ID tag
Sturdy daily leash + extra poop bag rolls clipped right to the leash
Colorful spiky bouncy ball + 1 or 2 favorite chew toys
Collapsible travel water bowl + dedicated gallon jug of water
5 days of kibble (plus scoop) and extra high-value treats / long-lasting chew for Trilith Thanksgiving dinner
Favorite dog bed/blanket so every hotel room smells instantly like home
Two old bath towels + paw wipes for dewy grass or rainy rest stops
Printed and phone copy of Winston's vaccination/vet records + any dog meds

categories.title: Clothes & Smart 3-Night Overnight Bags
categories.subtitle: Pack one quick-grab tote for Indy + Franklin so Jordan only hauls one bag into the first two hotels!

items.text: Shared Quick-Grab Overnight Tote for Night 1 (Indy) & Night 2 (Franklin)
Cozy, relaxed Thanksgiving dinner outfits for Prologue at Trilith Guesthouse
Warm layers: sweaters, casual jackets, and light rain jackets / compact umbrella
Comfortable loungewear, pajamas, and 4 days of underwear/socks for both of us
Move-in day clothes & sneakers for Friday Nov 27 at 306 Calgary Drive
Toiletries bag: toothbrushes, skincare, hairbrush, deodorant, glasses/contacts & solution
Laundry bag for worn road-trip clothes + small stain-remover pen

categories.title: Important Documents & Valuables (Always In Car!)
categories.subtitle: Never pack these on the moving truck; keep in one zippered folder up front.

items.text: Driver's licenses, passports, Social Security cards, birth certificates, and marriage certificate
Paid itemized Deljo furnace maintenance receipt (needed for Wed Nov 25 Chicago closing!)
Chicago home sale closing paperwork, checkbook, and wire/attorney contact sheet
Signed 306 Calgary Drive lease copy + Cecilia Taylor & Imlach/Atlas mover contact numbers
Auto insurance cards, new Georgia renter's insurance proof, and health insurance cards
Laptops, iPads, work chargers, external hard drives, and jewelry / irreplaceable keepsakes

categories.title: First-Night Survival Box (306 Calgary Dr)
categories.subtitle: So Friday evening at the new house is effortless even before boxes are unpacked.

items.text: Toilet paper (4 rolls), paper towels, hand soap, and dish soap
Heavy-duty trash bags, disinfectant wipes, and all-purpose counter spray
Box cutter / heavy scissors, painter's tape, and a Sharpie for labeling rooms
1 clean set of bed sheets, 2 sleeping pillows, and 2 bath towels
Shower curtain, plastic liner, rings, and bath mat
Power strip, extra phone chargers, and a small nightlight or flashlight
Morning coffee essentials, 2 mugs, disposable plates/utensils, and quick snacks

categories.title: Chicago Condo Close-Out (Tue Nov 24 Before 4:15 PM)
categories.subtitle: Quick final sweep of 2550 W Logan Blvd Unit 3F before pulling onto I-65 S.

items.text: Meet Deljo technician (2:00 to 4:00 PM CT, Ref #321873124) and save paid itemized receipt
Empty refrigerator/freezer, wipe down shelves, and run/empty dishwasher
Take out all trash/recycling and check every closet, drawer, cabinet, and storage locker
Snap final walkthrough photos of empty rooms and electric/gas meter readings (disconnects Nov 26)
Set thermostat to safe winter temp (~60 F), lock all windows/doors, and leave keys/fobs per closing instructions
